title: ERD Studio layers
description: Layer definitions: .erd-studio/layers.json. Each layer id is also the directory holding that layer's domain files. Reference: https://github.com/liam-machine/erd-studio/blob/main/docs/semantic-domain-json-reference.md#layers-file-erd-studiolayersjson

$schema.description: Optional schema reference for editors outside VS Code. Ignored by ERD Studio.

schemaVersion.description: Layers file format version. Must be 1.

layers.description: The layers, each with a unique id.

id.description: Lowercase identifier (letters, digits, hyphens, underscores). Also the directory name for this layer's domains.

creatable.description: Whether new domains can be created in this layer.
